content.short: Usual is a decentralized stablecoin protocol that issues USD0, a RWA-backed asset redistributing value to users.
content.description:
Usual is a pioneering decentralized finance protocol and stablecoin issuer designed to bring transparency and equity to the digital dollar landscape. Its flagship asset, USD0, is a permissionless stablecoin fully backed 1:1 by high-quality real-world assets (RWAs), primarily short-term US Treasury Bills. Unlike centralized competitors, Usual redistributes its protocol earnings and governance influence directly to its community through the $USUAL token, creating a more meritocratic financial ecosystem.

Operating on the Ethereum network, Usual provides a robust and scalable framework for on-chain asset management, collaborating with top-tier providers like BlackRock and Ondo to secure its collateral. The platform focuses on professional-grade compliance and security, serving as a vital bridge between traditional stability and decentralized innovation. Through its commitment to a user-centric monetary system, Usual is building the essential infrastructure for a more resilient and rewarding decentralized economy where users share in the success of the protocol.
content.meta: Usual provides the RWA-backed USD0 stablecoin and a decentralized governance model that rewards users.
